title: Compose Design Systems and CompositionLocal Check

questions.prompt: Which dependency is least appropriate for CompositionLocal?
questions.explanation: Business dependencies should remain explicit or enter through a clear injection boundary.

questions.prompt: Every one-off dimension should become a global design token.
questions.explanation: Tokens should represent coherent repeated product decisions rather than arbitrary values.

questions.prompt: What does a slot API expose?
questions.explanation: Callers can provide structured UI while the component preserves layout and behaviour.
